detailed_descriptions.en: EXPLORE THE HAB CLUSTER, FIND HAB 01! Wake up in a deteriorating underground facility with nothing but a mysterious request to find HAB 01. Explore the perilous interconnected labyrinth of what once was, help survivors, and ultimately dictate the fate of humanity with multiple endings. SHOOT & DODGE YOUR WAY THROUGH DANGEROUS ENEMIES AND BOSSES Utilize various items to dispatch the dangerous enemies that wander the halls of the hab cluster. Equip yourself with variety of guns, gadgets, and usable items to build your ideal loadout for any situation! FIND AND TEST OUT OVER 70+ WEAPONS Weapons have various qualities, like rate of fire, muzzle velocity, reload time, and penetration! Experiment and find out which are best for what situations and build a kit that suits your current needs! LOOT EQUIPMENT AND EXTRACT SAFELY Find weapons, armor, and gadgets while exploring the facility to build your arsenal. Survive to bring your spoils back to your hideout or... die and lose it all... SCAN YOUR LOOT AND FABRICATE THEM LATER! Collect over 200 useful items in your fabricator! Print them back at your hideout for a dangerous outing or prepare for a well equipped boss run!

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
EXPLORE THE HAB CLUSTER, FIND HAB 01!

Wake up in a deteriorating underground facility with nothing but a mysterious request to find HAB 01.

Explore the perilous interconnected labyrinth of what once was, help survivors, and ultimately dictate the fate of humanity with multiple endings.

SHOOT & DODGE YOUR WAY THROUGH DANGEROUS ENEMIES AND BOSSES

Utilize various items to dispatch the dangerous enemies that wander the halls of the hab cluster.

Equip yourself with variety of guns, gadgets, and usable items to build your ideal loadout for any situation!

FIND AND TEST OUT OVER 70+ WEAPONS

Weapons have various qualities, like rate of fire, muzzle velocity, reload time, and penetration!  Experiment and find out which are best for what situations and build a kit that suits your current needs!

LOOT EQUIPMENT AND EXTRACT SAFELY

Find weapons, armor, and gadgets while exploring the facility to build your arsenal.

Survive to bring your spoils back to your hideout or... die and lose it all...

SCAN YOUR LOOT AND FABRICATE THEM LATER!

Collect over 200 useful items in your fabricator!  Print them back at your hideout for a dangerous outing or prepare for a well equipped boss run!
